items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Well, we toured New England, and we toured Jersey.

ctx.x: Where all did Boy Raeburn's band tour?

Well, we toured New England, and we toured Jersey. We didn't go too far. We'd play around West Virginia and Washington, D. C. It used to be a kind of problem around there, you know. And near parts of Virginia around Washington.
